title: Basheshar Nath v. Commissioner of Income Tax

content.caseIdentity: Basheshar Nath v. Commissioner of Income Tax, AIR 1959 SC 149
content.holding: No individual can waive his fundamental rights under Article 14 or any other provision of Part III; the command of Part III binds the State unconditionally.
content.relevance: Locus classicus on the rejection of the Doctrine of Waiver in India.
